Application Data.NAME: Green Oasis Landscaping
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Oasis Landscaping provides professional garden and landscaping services, specializing in residential and commercial property maintenance, landscape design, installation, and seasonal upkeep. We source all plant materials from licensed nurseries, ensuring compliance with local agricultural regulations. Our operations include mowing, trimming, planting, mulching, and irrigation system installation and maintenance. We prioritize environmentally responsible practices and maintain detailed records of all sourced materials to mitigate risks associated with environmental damage and regulatory compliance.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a lawnmower malfunction caused damage to a client's property during a scheduled maintenance service, resulting in a claim of $2,500. The claim has been settled, and payment was made in full. Status: Closed. Additionally, on 09/10/2023, a truck incurred minor damage due to a tree branch falling during a storm while parked at the job site, with repair costs of $500. This claim is still pending, with repairs scheduled for completion by 11/01/2023.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed, Fire Resistant
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the property perimeter; two licensed watchpersons onsite during operations to ensure safety and compliance.
